Fix context token calculation to include cached tokens

Previously only counted input_tokens, but Claude API reports tokens across
three fields: input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, and cache_read_input_tokens.
These are mutually exclusive categories that together represent total context.

This was causing context pane to show ~3% when actual usage was ~70%.
